title: Add self-host artifact command log schema check

title: Add validator coverage for NEXT_PRIORITY_TASK-driven recovery mode
notes: done: Added recovery-mode validator checks requiring NEXT_PRIORITY_TASK.md alignment and deterministic regression coverage.

title: Add strict path normalization check for report file lists
notes: done: Enforced normalized repo-relative path validation for SELF_HOST_REPORT.json file lists and added deterministic regression coverage for traversal/absolute path drift.

title: Add deterministic test for status blocked traceability note quality
notes: done: Enforced actionable blocked-status note quality checks in self-host artifact validation and added deterministic regression coverage.
